identity.label: Roleplay keyword discovery
identity.summary: Discovery skill for choosing precise lorebook, skill, persona, and prompt-trigger keywords that activate entries only in relevant roleplay contexts without broad false positives.

source_links: AGENTS.md: Keyword and Discovery for AI Roleplay Generation

memory_routing: Store accepted keywords with the entry they activate, not as general prose guidance.
Revise keywords when testing shows frequent false positives, missed activations, or generic over-triggering.

guardrails: Use one to eight precise keywords per entry.
Avoid broad filler words and terms unlikely to be typed by users.
Keywords must align directly with the entry subject and retrieval intent.
